title: Write 14 · 坐 楼 忙 床 姐 课 同 星 期 网 门 球 书 口 杯
focus: 坐 楼 忙 床 姐 课 同 星 期 网 门 球 书 口 杯
body:
Home and school: 楼, 床, 门, 书, 杯, 课, 星期.

## Repeating parts
- **木 tree/wood** on the left of 楼 and 杯, and under 床's 广. On the left side, 木's last stroke shrinks to a dot.
- **口**: by itself and inside 同.
- **冂 frame** in 同 and 网.
- **王**: on the left of 球.

## Rules that matter here
- **Outside before inside:** write the 冂 of 同 and 网 before what goes inside it.
- **广 first:** in 床, the roof-and-wall 广 goes first, then 木 under it.

cards.Notes: Two 人 sitting on 土 ground. 7 strokes: left 人 (丿, 丶), right 人 (丿, 丶), then 土 (一, 丨, 一). Lookalike 座 zuò (seat) adds 广.
木 wood + 娄 lóu (phonetic). 13 strokes. 木 (with its last stroke as a dot), then 娄: 米 on top (丶, 丿, 一, 丨, 丿, 丶) over 女.
忄 heart + 亡 wáng (phonetic). 6 strokes. 忄: left dot, right dot, then the 丨. Then 亡 (丶, 一, ㄴ). Same parts as 忘 wàng (forget), stacked.
广 roof + 木 wood: a wooden bed. 7 strokes. 广 (丶, 一, 丿) first, then 木 under it. Lookalike 庆 qìng has 大.
女 woman + 且 qiě (phonetic). 8 strokes. 女 on the left (㇛, 丿, ㇀). Then 且 (丨, 𠃍, 一, 一, then the long bottom 一).
讠 speech + 果 guǒ (phonetic). 10 strokes. 讠 (丶, ㇊), then 果. The vertical of 果 runs from the top of 日 down through 木.
冂 frame, then 一, then 口 inside. 6 strokes. Write the outer 冂 (丨, 𠃌) first. Lookalike 问 has 门 (with a dot) around 口.
日 sun + 生 shēng (phonetic): a star. 9 strokes. 日 on top, then 生 (丿, 一, 一, 丨, 一).
其 qí (phonetic) + 月 moon (time). 12 strokes. 其: 一, 丨, 丨, 一, 一, long 一, 丿, 丶. Then 月.
A net: 冂 with two ㄨ inside. 6 strokes: 丨, 𠃌, then 丿 丶, then 丿 丶. Outside before inside. Lookalike 冈 gāng has one ㄨ.
A doorway. 3 strokes: 丶, 丨, then 𠃌 (the fold-hook on the right). There is no bottom stroke, so 问 and 们 stay open at the bottom.
王 jade + 求 qiú (phonetic). 11 strokes. 王 (its last stroke rises). Then 求: 一, 亅, ㇀, 丿, ㇏, and the top-right 丶 LAST.

cards.Prompt: 看＿ · kàn shū · to read a book
cards.Notes: 4 strokes: 乛 fold, a second folding stroke ending in a hook, then the long 丨 down the middle, then 丶 last. Simplified from 書.
A mouth. 3 strokes: 丨, 𠃍, then the bottom 一 closes it. Compare the bigger enclosure 囗 in 图 and 四.
木 wood + 不 bù (phonetic). 8 strokes. 木 (with its last stroke as a dot), then 不 (一, 丿, 丨, 丶).
